subject.title: Telegram agent: chatbot follow-up loop + exec tool aborts on pkill against earlier-spawned process

question: Should this combined report be split into a reply-policy invariant and an exec/process-control hardening task before implementation?
rationale: The source shows partial fixes and supported managed process tooling, but the remaining behavior spans product reply policy and lower-level shell/process semantics that automation should not collapse into one unreviewed fix.

options.title: Split into two tasks
options.body: Track Telegram action-only reply policy separately from raw exec/process-kill hardening and require live proof for each surface.

options.title: Keep as one coordinated bug
options.body: Use this issue as the parent for one broader fix, accepting a larger cross-surface review and validation burden.

options.title: Limit to existing process tool guidance
options.body: Treat managed `process kill` as the supported path and only improve docs/prompt guidance, leaving raw shell `pkill` behavior out of scope.

recommendation.title: Split into two tasks
recommendation.body: Track Telegram action-only reply policy separately from raw exec/process-kill hardening and require live proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The user-visible Telegram reply-policy half appears to need the clearest product decision before process-control implementation details can be scoped.
